title: Prediction of population behavior of Listeria monocytogenes in food using machine learning and a microbial growth and survival database
notes: Publisher supplementary files acquired and verified: S1 contains 2531 unique ComBase Record IDs; S2 contains 112 unique food names. The underlying ComBase record exports containing environmental metadata and time/count observations are still required to reconstruct the curves.

title: Data mining for prediction and interpretation of bacterial population behavior in food
notes: Eight-organism ComBase study; L. monocytogenes spans 13 food categories and 1192 environmental IDs. Use to identify later/expanded Listeria records after deduplication.

title: Machine learning modeling for predicting growth dynamics of Listeria monocytogenes using ComBase database: A comprehensive feature engineering approach
notes: 2026 curated ComBase study; 2632 observations across growth and inactivation. Useful for newer filtering/feature-engineering comparisons and candidate record discovery if supplementary identifiers are available.

title: Study of the effect of lethal and sublethal pH and aw stresses on the inactivation or growth of Listeria monocytogenes and Salmonella Typhimurium
notes: Used by Hiura et al. as external validation; culture medium example at pH 4.5, aw 0.997, 5 C. Do not train on this curve if retained for external validation.

title: Comparison of primary predictive models to study the growth of Listeria monocytogenes at low temperatures in liquid cultures and selection of fastest growing ribotypes in meat and turkey product slurries
notes: Used by Hiura et al. as external validation; TSB example at 4 C. Do not train on the retained validation curve.

title: Behavior of Salmonella and Listeria monocytogenes in Raw Yellowfin Tuna during Cold Storage
notes: Used by Hiura et al. as external validation; tuna example at 6 C. Open-access candidate for independent validation.
